metadata.description: A marketplace for GRU953-Studio: a Tier-sized team of specialised AI software developers, led by an AI project lead, that turns a plain-English idea and one short pop-up interview into a working, tested project on your own machine. A native Claude Code plugin — from 7.0.0 it targets Claude Code only, and every check it reports is one it actually ran.

plugins.name: gru953-studio
plugins.description: An AI project lead plus a Tier-sized team (Tiny/Standard/Complex) of up to 36 specialised roles. It interviews you once by pop-up multiple-choice questions (Semi-Structured + Panel + STAR), then researches, designs, plans, codes, reviews and tests without interrupting you again — proving each step by executing it, not by writing that it passed. It stops with a finished, tested project on your machine; pushing it anywhere stays your decision. Built for non-technical users, in plain UK English. Claude Code only from 7.0.0: the earlier support for other editors was never tested end to end and its own documentation called it best-effort, so it was withdrawn rather than left as a promise.
